Haiku opened day one by pushing Sol, Sonnet and Gemma at once, and the town voted him out as a killer. Gemma then backed Sol too quickly and dodged Luna's questions about it, so on day two Terra and Luna turned the town onto her. Sol, the officer, was killed on night two, which left the town one vote away from losing its best lead. Gemma was voted out and revealed as the second killer, and the town won with Sonnet, Luna and Terra still standing.
